description: This Python source file implements a Jira REST API client class 'JiraAPIClient' that handles communication with Jira Cloud's REST API, including methods for authentication, project retrieval, issue searching, and other Jira resource interactions.

classes.name: JiraAPIClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Jira Cloud REST API, encapsulating methods for various Jira operations such as fetching projects, issues, issue types, priorities, statuses, and testing connection.

methods.name: __init__(self, domain: str, email: str, api_token: str)
methods.description: Initializes the JiraAPIClient with domain, email, api_token, sets up headers for authentication.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _make_request( self, endpoint: str, method: str = "GET", params: Optional[Dict] = None, json_data: Optional[Dict] = None, timeout: float = 30.0 )
methods.description: Performs authenticated HTTP requests to Jira API endpoints with error handling for various HTTP response codes and connection issues.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] test_connection(self)
methods.description: Tests the connection to Jira by requesting user info.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_projects(self, expand: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Fetches all accessible Jira projects with optional field expansion.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_project(self, project_key: str, expand: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Fetches detailed information on a specific project identified by project key.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_project_components(self, project_key: str)
methods.description: Retrieves components of a specified project.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_project_versions(self, project_key: str)
methods.description: Retrieves versions of a specified project.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_project_roles(self, project_key: str)
methods.description: Fetches roles associated with a specified project.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] search_issues( self, jql: str, fields: Optional[str] = None, expand: Optional[str] = None, max_results: int = 50, start_at: int = 0 )
methods.description: Performs a JQL query to search for issues with optional field expansion and pagination.
